arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Saharsky argued the statutory text supports the government's position.
She stated a contrary reading would defeat Congress's purposes.
Mr. Giatras argued the government described a statute Congress did not pass.
He stated the final law requires a domestic relationship element.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the definition of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence. The government argues the statute covers broad domestic offenses. the opposing side argues the law requires a specific domestic relationship element.
